title: We Are Aliens Film, Eri Short Anime, Candy Caries Win at Ottawa Int'l Animation Festival
content: NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film , Honami Yano 's Eri animated short , and Tomoki Misato and Wit Studio 's original television anime Candy Caries were all awarded at the 50th Anniversary Awards Ceremony of the Ottawa International Animation Festival, on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Lynn
content: The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Sunday that Lynn will voice the character Eve, the eldest daughter of the Benfield family. The anime will air on TBS and other stations.
author: ANN

title: Imu Uses Domi Reversi in One Piece Episode 1180 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1180, showing Imu using the skill Domi Reversi while facing the giants. This will be the final episode of the year. The anime returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the crew reaching the giants’ Elbaph Island.
author: Anime Corner

title: Space Battleship Yamato Film Director Toshio Masuda Dies at 98
content: Newspapers Mainichi Shimbun and Yomiuri Shimbun both reported on Thursday that film director and screenwriter Toshio Masuda died of old age on August 26. He was 98. Masuda was born in Kobe in October 1927.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Creator Breaks Silence on New Anime
content: The Apothecary Diaries is one of the most popular anime, manga, and light novel franchises in the world. With over 57 million copies in circulation, the series has an anime adaptation and even a live-action in the works , along with the ongoing manga and light novel.

title: Toshio Masuda, Director of 'Uchuu Senkan Yamato' Movies, Dies at 98
content: Toshio Masuda , the director behind Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) movies, died on August 26 due to natural causes. He was 98. The Directors Guild of Japan announced the news on Thursday, stating that Masuda died at a hospital in Tokyo. A private funeral service has been held by his close relatives.
